A rank-154 minor modulo 3 and 14 separately verified independent integral two-cycles force rational second boundary rank 154; the first boundary rank is exactly 90. This proves integral top homology Z^14 and rational H1 rank eight. A natural chain map to graph chains surjects on H1 via eight short fundamental cycles, hence is a rational equivariant isomorphism. The exhaustive 336-element signed cellular Lefschetz calculation yields the character on every element, with character-square sum 672 and invariant average zero. The standalone code and certificate were executed from the actual scientific package directory, not inferred from logs alone.

originality.rationale: The accepted increment is the complete rational second-homology representation under all 336 point/line preserving and exchanging automorphisms of the Heawood graph, including two nonisomorphic complex irreducibles and a rationally acyclic quotient. The known homology ranks and graph-braid abelianization from Ko–Park (2011) are not claimed new. Barnett–Farber (2009) concerns ordered configurations, and existing symmetry calculations on the Heawood graph concern different complexes. No indexed result was found implying the full eight-row signed character, although unindexed work and an unlocated broader formula remain risks.

value.rationale: This is the full symmetry character on a natural fourteen-dimensional top homology module of the canonical fourteen-vertex Fano incidence graph. Point–line dualities supply nonredundant class values; the module has two distinct complex irreducible constituents and no invariants under 336 automorphisms, yielding a rationally acyclic quotient despite nonzero homology upstairs. These are mathematically motivated exact invariants of an exceptional symmetric graph, beyond its already-known Betti numbers; no unsupported graph-family generalization is asserted.
